title: feat(nspary): parallel-opposite y-probe unique vector: reverse UNDEFINED, face fails
science: Neighbour-lock vector readout on parallel-opposite y-probes; C=(0,2,0) has four recorded neighbours all locking +e_2 so L(C)=+e_2 is defined, and face fails against L(D)=-e_1. One of only three members in the band where face is `fail` rather than UNDEFINED.
